changelog.title: Metadata Auto-Heal & File Manager Multi-Select v1.0.3
changes: Auto-healing for server metadata (.mcmeta.json) preventing 'Server metadata not found' crash
System-level file protection for .mcmeta.json in File Manager (deletion & renaming locked)
Select All checkbox in File Manager with automatic preservation of system metadata
Batch deletion support with confirmation dialog for quick backup cleanups
Refresh button in File Manager toolbar for instant file list sync

changelog.title: Server Port Fix, File Upload & Archive Extraction v1.0.2
changes: Fixed 'Port 0 is already in use' error with smart regex matching and auto-healing server.properties
Orphan Java process detection and automated cleanup to prevent port locks
Fixed File Manager upload TypeError on drag-and-drop using Electron webUtils
Added native 1-click in-app archive extraction for .zip, .rar, .tar.gz, and .7z archives
Added server port validation in Properties editor to prevent invalid configurations
Added graceful shutdown handler preventing world and property corruption

changelog.title: ViaVersion & Hot-Patch Update v1.0.1
changes: Fixed ViaVersion, ViaBackwards, ViaRewind and EssentialsX 404 download errors
Direct Modrinth CDN version resolution for 100% reliable downloads
GitHub live hot-patch sync on relaunch without reinstalling .exe

changelog.title: Initial Release v1.0.0
changes: Live Modrinth Plugin Manager with real-time search & 25+ curated catalog
Multi-Platform Server JAR resolver (Auto Paper/Spigot detection)
Support for Minecraft 26.2 (Chaos Cubed) & 26.1 (Tiny Takeover)
Multi-Version Java Manager (Java 25, 21, 17) with auto-detection & manual override
Direct GitHub Hot-Update engine
Automated Minecraft Paper server creation and live interactive console
Advanced File Manager with in-app file editor
World Manager with zip import/export
Playit Tunnel Beta integration UI
Premium dark glassmorphism theme with smooth micro-animations
